notes: An experiment verifies only its explicitly declared bounded fixtures, not the full upstream claims.
Excluded = removed from the CURRENT active backlog (priority C) or exact duplicate (D); an excluded paper may already have a completed full-text source review.
Reviewed = full paper or full first-party engineering material was assessed, but no isolated project experiment was confirmed.
Awaiting validation = found/triaged in source audit but missing required full-text or reproducible target measurements; an existing GitHub repository does not constitute a runtime test.
Hub study card mapping is only for matching titles; related research from the hub outside the Telegram list must not be counted as original Telegram entries.
Original Telegram chronology is reconstructed from the preserved audit; the original Telegram message byte stream was not available for independent comparison.
BK-041 has a permission-gate lab report but is still AWAITING a real eBPF tracer experiment. Linked reports do not imply successful target-capability verification.
